low_bin_definition: 0 < element mass percent <= 0.1; an initial statistical reporting convention of this design, not a detection limit and not a claim about real samples
mid_high_definition: mid = 0.1 < x <= 0.5 * declared maximum element percent for that element; high = x > that half-maximum. Declared maxima come from B_design_ranges.json (compound maxima converted to elements, trace maxima in ppm/10000), so unreachable bins stay visible
exact_zero_definition: the recipe adds no compound or trace carrying that element; it is not a claim that a physical sample is non-detect

exempt.Fe: required iron matrix of the iron-rich oxide design; never asked to be zero
exempt.O: stoichiometric matrix bookkeeping, not a direct fluorescence target of this model version

notes: mid band is degenerate by definition, not a coverage failure: half of the declared maximum 0.15 percent is 0.075, at or below the low-bin ceiling 0.1, so every value above the low bin is counted as high
Co.target: >= 50 exact-zero and >= 50 low recipes per applicable element

largest_family_evidence.note: near-neighbour merging is transitive (union-find), so a chain of individually close constructed families can end up under one label; this only ever makes the global family split more conservative, it never splits one constructed control group across folds

iron_rich_criterion_verification.criterion: Fe2O3T in [40,75] mass percent (elemental Fe in [27.977,52.458] percent under the Fe2O3 stoichiometry assumption) AND Fe strictly larger than every other candidate target AND strict closure of the element sum to 100 percent within 1e-6 points

near_neighbour_grouping.rule: two distinct recipes are near-neighbours when the maximum absolute difference over the unified 33-element vector is <= 0.10 absolute element percent points; near-neighbours are merged into one parent_family (deterministic: smallest family label wins)

block_construction_proof.note: per-block zero/low counts are the arithmetic evidence behind the gap list in B_coverage.json; the routine and interference blocks are randomly drawn or control-structured, so no per-element zero/low quota is claimed for them
